tasks.analysis: The study of the universe is called cosmology. The scope of this field is extremely large, encompassing everything from the smallest particles to vast galaxies. One intriguing hypothesis in cosmology is the Big Bang Theory, according to which the universe began approximately 13.8 billion years ago from an infinitely dense point. Cosmologists also study dark matter and dark energy. They observe cosmic microwave background radiation, the faint glow left over from the Big Bang, to gather information about the universe in its early days. 研究宇宙的学科被称为宇宙学。该领域的研究范围极其广阔，涵盖了从最小微观粒子到浩瀚星系的一切事物。宇宙学中一个备受关注的假说就是大爆炸理论。该理论认为，宇宙起源于约 138 亿年前一个密度无限大的奇点。宇宙学家同时也研究暗物质与暗能量。他们观测宇宙微波背景辐射 —— 大爆炸残留的微弱光晕，以此获取宇宙早期的相关信息。
